title: In situ Nuclear Matrix Preparation in Drosophila melanogaster for Genetic Analysis
author: Pathak, Bihani, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and plates
steps.instruction: Prepare grape‑juice agar plates for embryo collection; prepare all stock solutions; sterilize stock solutions by autoclaving.

steps.title: Settle embryos and remove methanol
steps.instruction: Allow embryos to settle and gently aspirate to discard methanol.

steps.title: Wash embryos with PBT three times
steps.instruction: Fill tube with 1 mL PBT, let embryos settle, discard supernatant; repeat this wash three consecutive times (for larval tissue, wash fixed tissue in chambered slides).

steps.title: Rehydrate embryos (if needed)
steps.instruction: Rehydrate embryos three times for 20 min each with 1 mL pre‑chilled PBT while rotating at 40 rpm at 25 °C (skip for tissues already in aqueous medium).

steps.title: Aliquot control embryos
steps.instruction: Aliquot a few embryos/tissues into 1.5 mL microfuge tubes containing 0.5 mL PBT, store at 4 °C; prepare two aliquots if both immunofluorescence and TEM are required, to serve as untreated controls.

steps.title: Stabilization incubation (optional)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL PBT to each tube, incubate at 25 °C for 20 min, then discard supernatant by gentle aspiration (step may be omitted).

steps.title: Salt extraction I
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL EB I (prepared fresh, used same day) to tube or chambered slide, incubate on rotating wheel/platform shaker at 40 rpm for 20 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Salt extraction II
steps.instruction: Allow embryos to settle, discard supernatant, add fresh 1 mL EB II (freshly prepared), incubate at 40 rpm for 20 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Wash with PBT three times
steps.instruction: Wash embryos/tissues three times, each wash 10 min with PBT while rotating/shaking at 40 rpm.

steps.title: Remove residual buffer
steps.instruction: Let tube stand 2 min for embryos to settle, then carefully aspirate the buffer.

steps.title: DNase I digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL digestion buffer (DB) containing 2 µL DNase I (10 mg/mL, prepared fresh) to embryos/tissues, incubate at 37 °C in shaker incubator for 50 min at 200 rpm.

steps.title: Final wash after digestion
steps.instruction: Repeat the three 10‑min PBT washes as in the earlier wash step.

steps.title: Split samples for downstream analysis
steps.instruction: Divide the contents of each 1.5 mL tube into two microfuge tubes; one for immunofluorescence, the other for TEM.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody to empirically optimized concentration, add to both untreated control and NuMat samples in 0.5 mL PBT, seal with parafilm, and incubate with rotation for 3 h at 25 °C (alternatively 12–16 h at 4 °C). For tissue, add antibody directly to chambered slide.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Perform the three 10‑min PBT washes as before.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute fluorescent secondary antibody as optimized, add to samples in 0.5 mL PBT, seal with parafilm, and incubate with rotation for 3 h at 25 °C; protect from light by wrapping tubes in aluminum foil.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Perform the three 10‑min PBT washes as before.

steps.title: Transfer to glass slide
steps.instruction: After final wash, let embryos settle, discard supernatant, add a small amount of PBT, and pipette embryos/tissues onto a glass slide using cut tips; gently aspirate excess solution without losing material.

steps.title: Add mounting media with DAPI
steps.instruction: Add appropriate volume of mounting medium containing DAPI (handle DAPI with care as it is potentially carcinogenic).

steps.title: Mount coverslip and seal
steps.instruction: Place coverslip gently with a needle to avoid bubbles and crushing, then seal all four sides with transparent nail polish; store slides in dark boxes or slide books, optionally at 4 °C for up to 16 h, and image within one day.

steps.title: Image slides by confocal microscopy
steps.instruction: Scan slides on a confocal or multiphoton microscope (e.g., Leica SP8) using 20× and 63× objectives; process images with LAS X software to generate projection images.

steps.title: Fix samples for TEM
steps.instruction: Add 2 % glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer to both control and NuMat samples, rotate for 1 h at 4 °C (glutaraldehyde is toxic; handle in fume hood).

steps.title: Settle and discard fixation buffer
steps.instruction: Allow samples to settle by gravity and gently aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with cacodylate buffer
steps.instruction: Wash samples three times with 0.1 M cacodylate buffer, each wash adding buffer, rotating for 5 min at 4 °C, then settling and discarding supernatant; samples may be stored at 4 °C for 12–16 h in the same buffer.

steps.title: Postfix with osmium tetroxide
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in 1 % OsO₄ in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer, rotating for 30 min at 4 °C (OsO₄ is extremely toxic; use full protective equipment).

steps.title: Dehydrate with 35 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Incubate samples in 35 % ethanol (in 0.1 M cacodylate) with rotation for 10 min at 4 °C, then settle and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol series dehydration
steps.instruction: Repeat the 10‑min, 4 °C rotation dehydration and discard steps with ethanol concentrations of 50 %, 70 %, 80 %, 90 %, 95 % and 100 %; perform an additional wash in 100 % ethanol.

steps.title: Incubate with ethanol:n‑butyl alcohol 2:1
steps.instruction: Add ethanol:n‑butyl alcohol (nBA) mixture at 2:1 ratio, rotate at 25 °C for 10 min (freshly prepared).

steps.title: Incubate with ethanol:n‑butyl alcohol 1:2
steps.instruction: Settle, discard supernatant, add ethanol:nBA at 1:2 ratio, rotate at 25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Incubate with 100 % n‑butyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Settle, discard supernatant, add 100 % n‑BA, rotate at 25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Embed in n‑BA:DGD 2:1 at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Add n‑BA:DGD mixture (2:1) freshly prepared, rotate at 60 °C for 1 h, then discard supernatant.

steps.title: Embed in n‑BA:DGD 1:2 at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Add n‑BA:DGD mixture (1:2), rotate at 60 °C for 1 h, then discard supernatant.

steps.title: Embed in 100 % DGD (first hour)
steps.instruction: Add 100 % DGD, rotate for 1 h at 25 °C, then discard supernatant.

steps.title: Embed in 100 % DGD (second hour)
steps.instruction: Repeat the 100 % DGD incubation for another 1 h at 25 °C, then discard supernatant.

steps.title: Solidify DGD block
steps.instruction: Incubate samples with DGD at 25 °C until the resin solidifies; if samples adhere to tube walls, pipette a small amount of DGD onto sides to bring them down. DGD‑embedded samples can be stored indefinitely at 25 °C.

steps.title: Extract DGD block from tube
steps.instruction: Cut the microfuge tube with a sharp blade and remove the solid DGD block containing the sample.

steps.title: Trim and ultramicrotome sections
steps.instruction: Trim the block and cut 70–90 nm sections using a glass knife on an ultramicrotome set at a 10° angle; float sections on water.

steps.title: Collect sections on copper grids
steps.instruction: Transfer floating sections onto formvar‑coated copper grids with a loop and let dry for 2 h.

steps.title: Remove DGD from grids
steps.instruction: Dip the grids containing sections in n‑BA and incubate for 12–16 h to dissolve residual DGD.

steps.title: Dry grids and image by TEM
steps.instruction: Dry the grids and observe under TEM at 120 kV; perform all steps in a dust‑free environment to avoid contamination of sections and EM grids.
